observations.body: Moses records the words, the people twice promise obedience, blood is placed on altar and people, and representatives ascend, see Israel’s God, and eat and drink.

payload.posture: Read Exodus 24:1–11 as covenant at the mountain evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The passage joins dangerous divine vision with preserved life and a communal meal without explaining the vision in ordinary physical terms.
